events.title: Saipem SpA (SAPMF) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong EBITDA Growth Amidst Flat Revenue
events.body: Saipem SpA (SAPMF) reports a 24% increase in EBITDA and maintains a robust liquidity position despite challenges in the drilling offshore segment.

events.title: Saipem secures $150m contract for Longtail project in Guyana
events.body: The contract covers EPCI of a subsea SURF system at a water depth of approximately 1,750m.

events.body: Saipem and COOEC boost upstream contracts activity.
